The '''Nature Altar''' is a [[runic altar]] upon which [[nature rune]]s are crafted from [[pure essence]], providing 9 [[Runecraft]] [[experience]] per essence imbued. Level 44 [[Runecraft]] is required to craft nature runes.

Players may create a [[nature tiara]] here by using either a [[nature talisman]] or a [[tiara]] on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 45 [[Runecraft]] [[experience]]. A [[catalytic tiara]] can also be created here by using a [[catalytic talisman]] and [[gold tiara]], granting 42.5 Runecraft experience.

Upon entering the Nature Altar, the [[music]] track [[Understanding]] plays.

==Transportation==
{{Map|name=Nature Altar|align=left|mtype=pin|x = 2868|y = 3018|height = 275|width = 275|caption = The location of the mysterious ruins used to enter the Nature Altar.}}
The entrance to the altar can be found north of [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]]; players can teleport close by via [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|ckr}} or using the [[Achievement diary cape]] teleport to [[Kaleb Paramaya]] along with the [[Rocks (Shilo Village)|rocks]] shortcut requiring 79 [[Agility]]. The altar can also be accessed through the [[Abyss]].

To enter the [[Mysterious ruins#Nature|mysterious ruins]], players either have to use a [[nature talisman]] on the ruins, or click "Enter" on the ruins while wearing a [[nature tiara]]. Alternatively, a [[catalytic talisman]] or [[catalytic tiara|tiara]] can be used.
{{Clear}}
==Experience==
The maximum likely limit for crafting nature runes in one visit is 134. This would be achieved by having 91 Runecraft, giving a 2x bonus, and carrying 67 essence to craft (27 in the normal inventory along with 40 in the [[colossal pouch]]). The maximum possible experience is 603 obtained while doing the above with pure essence. It will give 904.5 experience with [[daeyalt essence]].
